dispositions.method: The automatic families first printed in 1795 that reach 3 or more papers, long-running ones included, were split into single printed items (story_items.py --long-running, items.json: 481 items found on the pages, 145 in 4 or more papers by the finder's count), and again with the families of 1794 over the 1795 pages (items_from_1794.json: 65 items found, 16 in 4 or more). Every item in 3 or more papers was compared by machine with every page and counted again by its opening; a sweep of seven-word sequences shared by 4 or more papers found 446 runs, and the runs no finder item covers were read. Counted item by item (153 entries; the daily proceedings of Congress and of the state legislatures left out as digests), 130 items meet the bar (count_1795.md); where an item's family or run also holds other texts (the acts share their formulas), its papers were counted by its own words. The admitted and chosen items were counted again by their own words over all 1,668 pages in both transcriptions, and read on every page.
dispositions.selection_rule: The thin-year rule (Y-THIN, as amended on 23 November 2026, the owner's choice B1): an item, counted by its own words, is eligible when it was printed by more than half of the newspapers that survive for its weeks (those with a surviving issue between its first and last printing, and at least in the three weeks from its first printing), and by at least 4; as in R-01, the eligible items printed by every newspaper that survives for their weeks are admitted, and the other eligible items are chosen to cover the months and the kinds of news, about as many stories as a standard year (about 20 to 35); one affair's items as in X-1800-01; digests are not admitted; sub-stories (C-01), private persons (R-04) and the list of items read and not admitted (R-03) as in every year. In 1795 4 to 8 papers survive for an item's weeks, so the bar is 4 or 5.
dispositions.paper_counting: 1795 has 11 catalogue series, which are 9 papers (C-04, X-1795-02): the Gazette of the United States (200 issues, daily, under two catalogue numbers, to 30 June and from 8 July, to 30 November), the New-Hampshire Gazette (52), the Kentucky Gazette (49), the Concord paper (44: The Mirrour to 3 April, The Federal Mirror from 10 April), the American Herald of Liberty (29), the Columbian Informer (16, to 21 April), the Patowmac Guardian (12), The Eagle (8, May to October) and The Phoenix (1, 17 January). No 1795 issue has a corrected date; the release's map lists 5 misfiled RevX pages of 1795, none of them a page of this ledger.

counted_item_by_item.Paper counts: Of 130 items eligible by the count, 3 are printed by every paper that survives for their weeks, counted by their own words, and are admitted: the King's speech at the opening of Parliament (7 of 7), the brig Lydia's news from Amsterdam (6 of 6) and Commodore Warren's dispatches from Quiberon Bay (4 of 4). 18 are chosen; the others are listed as not chosen, except five items on private persons, listed for the owner.
counted_item_by_item.The treaty with Great Britain by its own: The treaty is in 4 papers by its own words: the Patowmac Guardian's printing of 18 July is 'concluded from our last', and its issue of 11 July does not survive (C-06); the Kentucky Gazette's essay of 3 October and the Gazette of the United States' commentaries quote its articles (C-07); the Gazette of the United States has no issue from 1 to 7 July.
counted_item_by_item.Printed forms counted together: The paragraph on the President's message on the Georgia lands, the sloop Delia's report and Commodore Warren's dispatches in a Philadelphia or London form and a New York form; the treaty with Prussia in two translations (C-02). The Patowmac Guardian's own paragraph on the French ships in the Chesapeake is another text and is not counted with the Baltimore letter.
counted_item_by_item.The acts by their own words: The automatic families join the acts of Congress and of New Hampshire by their formulas; counted by each act's opening, the naturalization act is in 5 papers and the others in 3 or fewer (below the bar).
